extracted.name: Strawberry and Spinach Salad with Honey Balsamic Vinaigrette
extracted.description: This strawberry spinach salad is a colorful, delicious, and easy summer dish with crunchy nuts and Gorgonzola cheese in a honey balsamic vinaigrette.
ingredient_lines: salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Combine spinach, strawberries, Gorgonzola cheese, and pecans in a large bowl.
Stir together balsamic vinegar and honey in a medium bowl; slowly stream in olive oil while whisking continuously. Season with salt and pepper.
Drizzle dressing over spinach mixture just before serving.
